changeSet.author: pc
changeSet.comment: lib-jobs v0.2.0+ backfill (2/2): move the staged log text into job_logs, one row per job (per-line timestamps were never preserved by the old single-column design, so a historical job's full log becomes a single job_logs row), then drop the staging column. Must run after the lib-jobs library changeset has created job_logs and dropped jobs.log, so it lives in this separate directory and is included explicitly from changelog-master.json after that library include, rather than being swept up by the includeAll of db/migration/changes/ like every other app-owned changeset.

sql.sql: INSERT INTO job_logs (job_id, message, created_at) SELECT id, log_backfill, COALESCE(updated_at, created_at) FROM jobs WHERE log_backfill IS NOT NULL AND log_backfill <> ''
